data.one_liner: Universal and customizable back gesture for any custom page transitions in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a configurable edge swipe back gesture that works with custom page transitions and standard routers like GoRouter. Allows customization of detection areas, velocity thresholds, swipe distance, and animation curves.
use_when: You want to add an interactive swipe-to-pop gesture to custom page transitions
You need fine-grained control over swipe sensitivity, thresholds, and animation curves for going back
avoid_when: You are satisfied with the default platform-specific back gestures provided by Flutter
Your navigation setup does not use custom page transitions or standard PageTransitionsTheme builders
strengths: Highly customizable gesture parameters including swipe area, range, and velocity thresholds
Works across multiple platforms (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux)
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration for custom route setups
Not a drop-in replacement for standard routing without setting up PageTransitionsTheme or custom Page routes

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are looking for a complete declarative routing and deep linking solution rather than just back gesture handling.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need strongly typed route generation and advanced navigation features.
